verdict.rationale: Square documents an official Model Context Protocol server, which lets a user drive Square through an external AI client using natural-language requests. It also publishes llms.txt to help AI tools consume its docs. Natural-language operation therefore depends on a third-party agent rather than a built-in assistant, and the evidence for the MCP server is only a docs title and a probe hit. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, details of which operations the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works.
